🙋🏻‍♀️ Join my free Discord community https://discord.gg/z8MHcfpZRQ

In this video, I'll go over 15 questions product managers can ask you and 5 things they are looking for in an interview. If you are interviewing for a product designer role in Silicon Valley, it's likely you will have 1 round of interview with a product manager in your final onsite interview. I will share my first hand experience in those interviews, what I know, what I got asked before, what I learned, and how you might take action to better prepare for them.

2. Go to "ux-pricing" channel to see offerings
3. Follow step 1 & 2. DM me on Discord if you have questions.
